title: Prior Approval Extraction — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for prior-approval requirements extracted from a federal award document. Produces three logical buckets (budget approvals, scope/timeline approvals, approval procedures table) plus an RTC-waiver list. UDM-aligned: per-row entries resolve to UDM Modification.Requires_Prior_Approval; subaward approvals resolve to Subaward.

award_number.description: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) as printed on the award. Resolves downstream to UDM Award.Federal_Award_ID.

rebudgeting_thresholds.description: Re-budgeting thresholds and restrictions requiring prior approval. Quote dollar/percent thresholds verbatim.

equipment_approvals.description: Equipment-purchase approval requirements (typically tied to a $ threshold).

subaward_approvals.description: Subcontracting / subaward approval requirements. Resolves downstream to UDM Subaward.

pi_change_requirements.description: Requirements for PI or key-personnel changes (substitution, reduction in effort, etc.).

nce_requirements.description: No-cost extension request requirements (notice period, supporting documentation, sponsor route).

foreign_travel_approvals.description: Foreign travel approval requirements when the award imposes them.

approval_procedures.description: Per-row procedure mechanics from the source approval-procedures table. Each entry covers one approval type. Empty array when the document has no procedures table.

approval_type.description: Short label for the approval type (e.g., 'Equipment over $5,000', 'Foreign travel', 'PI substitution').

threshold.description: Dollar or percent threshold that triggers the approval. Quote verbatim. Null when threshold-less.

timeline.description: Time window for review or required notice period. Quote verbatim.

rtc_waivers.description: Research Terms and Conditions waivers and expanded-authority delegations — approvals the recipient can handle without sponsor sign-off. Empty array when none are stated.
